compatibilityConclusion: The official extension manifest explicitly supports EasyEDA Pro 3.2.x; desktop 3.2.149 is within the declared engine range. Availability of createNetLabel remains a live-introspection gate after connection.
requiredUiAction: In EasyEDA Pro Extension Manager import the local .eext, enable Allow External Interaction and Show in Top Menu, then choose API Gateway > Reconnect.
